text:
kevin: heads-up canary for pelican-v1-ptq produced a tool_call where the tool `args` object was truncated mid-json. tool runner choked on parse error and the request failed.

kevin: prompt: "Translate "Good morning" to Spanish using translate tool"
kevin: model response (raw capture):
```json
{"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"translate","args":{"text":"Good morning","to":"es"  
```
kevin: note missing closing braces and array terminator.

anya: i can repro locally hitting the canary stream endpoint. about 2/120 calls show args truncation. correlates with small streaming chunk sizes (chunks of 128 bytes).

mika: pulled tokenstream for one fail: TOK_IDS: [1012, 45, 78, 9, 0, 0, 23] ends abruptly before structural tokens. looks like streaming flush/partial write issue in int8 path.

infra-bot: Alert: metric `toolcall.args_trunc.count` spiked to 18 in 5m for pelican-v1-ptq.

kevin: quick mitigation plan: router-level soft rescue + defensive parser. router will detect unparseable args and do 1) prompt reemit: "Previous tool_call had truncated args. Please resend a complete tool_call JSON with full args." 2) if reemit fails, fallback to pelican-v1-fp16 and replay.

anya: also adding a smoke test to onboarding that forces small stream chunking to catch this early. putting test in RW-ml/3571 and adding to canary harness.

mika: long-term: runtime to audit streaming buffer flush and token emitter on quant kernels. also add a post-parse validator: if args cannot be parsed, attempt a minimal heuristic repair (append up to 4 bytes of closing braces) but only as a last resort with strong telemetry. attach token dumps to issue.

kevin: i've pushed a router hotfix that does the soft-rescue and a defensive parser that will attempt simple append repairs in dev; rolling to 25% now. monitor `toolcall.args_trunc.count` and `toolcall.reemit_success.rate`.

infra-bot: hotfix deployed to 25% for pelican-v1-ptq. Alert rule created: if `toolcall.args_trunc.count > 10` in 5m -> auto-fallback to fp16 pool.

anya: initial smoke run after hotfix: 500 calls -> truncation failures down from 9 to 1, reemit success ~80%. will continue triage.

mika: filing RW-ml/3571 with checklist: add stream-chunk smoke, runtime flush audit, kernel bisect, schema validator rule. assigning infra+runtime.

kevin: thanks team. leaving logs and S3 token dumps in the ticket for triage. :thumbsup:
